payload.summary: CME: curated WA learning-opportunity directory with event freshness and bundle/employer-access checks
payload.detail: Review items F23, F38, D21. Separate provider, programme, event and recorded resource; expire past events, flag cancellations, keep historical pages apart; show 'included in your workshop' or 'available through your employer' before suggesting a purchase. Needs ongoing content upkeep and source-register ownership, so decide who maintains it before building.
payload.source: Master product review 2026-09-26 (thread: Review master review ideas); cross-checked against main 004ab6301
